<file path="app/models/product_model.py">
"""
app/models/product_model.py
Quản lý dữ liệu Sản phẩm, Biến thể (Variants) và SEO chuẩn E-commerce.
Hỗ trợ Soft Delete, Slug generation, Barcode generation, và đồng bộ hình ảnh.
Tối ưu hóa bảo vệ Payload và kiểm tra an toàn Supabase RLS Constraints.
"""

import logging
import re
import uuid
from datetime import datetime
from app.utils.supabase_client import get_supabase

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class ProductModel:

    @staticmethod
    def _db():
        return get_supabase()

    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    #  UTILITIES & FORMATTERS
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    @staticmethod
    def generate_slug(name: str) -> str:
        """Tạo slug không dấu chuẩn SEO: 'Áo Thun GUA' -> 'ao-thun-gua'"""
        if not name:
            return ""
        slug = name.lower()
        slug = re.sub(r'[áàảãạăắằẳẵặâấầẩẫậ]', 'a', slug)
        slug = re.sub(r'[éèẻẽẹêếềểễệ]', 'e', slug)
        slug = re.sub(r'[íìỉĩị]', 'i', slug)
        slug = re.sub(r'[óòỏõọôốồổỗộơớờởỡợ]', 'o', slug)
        slug = re.sub(r'[úùủũụưứừửữự]', 'u', slug)
        slug = re.sub(r'[ýỳỷỹỵ]', 'y', slug)
        slug = re.sub(r'[đ]', 'd', slug)
        slug = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9\s-]', '', slug)
        slug = re.sub(r'[\s-]+', '-', slug).strip('-')
        return slug

    @staticmethod
    def generate_barcode(product_id: str = None) -> str:
        """
        Sinh mã vạch duy nhất theo format: GUA-YYMM-XXXXXX
        - GUA     : Thương hiệu
        - YYMM    : Năm + Tháng tạo (VD: 2605 = tháng 5/2026)
        - XXXXXX  : 6 ký tự hex đầu của UUID (lấy từ product_id nếu có)
        """
        now = datetime.now()
        prefix = f"GUA-{now.strftime('%y%m')}"

        if product_id:
            hex_part = str(product_id).replace("-", "")[:6].upper()
        else:
            hex_part = uuid.uuid4().hex[:6].upper()

        return f"{prefix}-{hex_part}"

    # Bảng từ điển màu chuẩn Fashion
    COLOR_DICT = {
        'đen': '#000000', 'black': '#000000',
        'trắng': '#ffffff', 'white': '#ffffff',
        'đỏ': '#dc2626', 'red': '#dc2626',
        'xanh dương': '#2563eb', 'blue': '#2563eb',
        'xanh navy': '#1e3a8a', 'navy': '#1e3a8a',
        'xanh lá': '#16a34a', 'green': '#16a34a',
        'vàng': '#eab308', 'yellow': '#eab308',
        'cam': '#ea580c', 'orange': '#ea580c',
        'hồng': '#ec4899', 'pink': '#ec4899',
        'tím': '#9333ea', 'purple': '#9333ea',
        'xám': '#6b7280', 'gray': '#6b7280', 'grey': '#6b7280',
        'nâu': '#78350f', 'brown': '#78350f',
        'be': '#f5f5dc', 'beige': '#f5f5dc',
        'kem': '#fef3c7', 'cream': '#fef3c7'
    }

    @staticmethod
    def _format_product(product: dict) -> dict:
        """Format dữ liệu 1 sản phẩm: sắp xếp ảnh, tính giảm giá, map màu."""
        if not product:
            return product

        imgs = sorted(product.get("product_images") or [], key=lambda x: x.get("sort_order", 0))
        product["product_images"] = imgs
        product["images"] = imgs

        if not product.get("thumbnail_url"):
            primary = next((img["url"] for img in imgs if img.get("is_primary")), None)
            product["thumbnail_url"] = primary or (imgs[0]["url"] if imgs else "https://placehold.co/600x800/f8f8f8/cccccc?text=GUA")

        price = product.get("price")
        old_price = product.get("old_price")
        if price and old_price and old_price > price:
            product["discount_percent"] = int(100 - (price / old_price * 100))
        else:
            product["discount_percent"] = None

        variants = product.get("product_variants") or []
        for v in variants:
            c_hex = v.get("color_hex")
            if not c_hex or c_hex == "#1a1a1a":
                c_name = (v.get("color_name") or "").lower().strip()
                v["color_hex"] = ProductModel.COLOR_DICT.get(c_name, "#e5e5e5")
        product["product_variants"] = variants

        return product

    @staticmethod
    def fix_missing_slugs() -> int:
        """Backfill slug cho các sản phẩm bị thiếu trong DB."""
        db = ProductModel._db()
        fixed = 0
        try:
            res = db.table("products").select("id, name, slug").execute()
            for p in (res.data or []):
                if p.get("slug") and p["slug"] not in ("None", "null", ""):
                    continue
                new_slug = ProductModel.generate_slug(p.get("name", ""))
                if not new_slug:
                    continue
                db.table("products").update({"slug": new_slug}).eq("id", p["id"]).execute()
                fixed += 1
            return fixed
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Lỗi fix_missing_slugs: {e}")
            return 0

    @staticmethod
    def fix_missing_barcodes() -> int:
        """Backfill barcode cho các sản phẩm cũ chưa có."""
        db = ProductModel._db()
        fixed = 0
        try:
            res = db.table("products").select("id, created_at, barcode").execute()
            for p in (res.data or []):
                if p.get("barcode"):
                    continue
                created = p.get("created_at", "")
                try:
                    dt = datetime.fromisoformat(created.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
                    prefix = f"GUA-{dt.strftime('%y%m')}"
                except Exception:
                    prefix = f"GUA-{datetime.now().strftime('%y%m')}"

                hex_part = p["id"].replace("-", "")[:6].upper()
                barcode = f"{prefix}-{hex_part}"
                db.table("products").update({"barcode": barcode}).eq("id", p["id"]).execute()
                fixed += 1
            return fixed
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Lỗi fix_missing_barcodes: {e}")
            return 0

    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    #  READ (GET)
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    @staticmethod
    def get_categories(limit: int = 3) -> list:
        db = ProductModel._db()
        try:
            res = db.table("categories").select("*").limit(limit).execute()
            return res.data or []
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Lỗi get_categories: {e}")
            return []

    @staticmethod
    def get_featured(limit: int = 8) -> list:
        db = ProductModel._db()
        try:
            res = (
                db.table("products")
                .select("*, categories(name, slug), product_images(*), product_variants(*)")
                .is_("deleted_at", "null")
                .eq("is_active", True)
                .order("created_at", desc=True)
                .limit(limit)
                .execute()
            )
            return [ProductModel._format_product(item) for item in (res.data or [])]
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Lỗi get_featured: {e}")
            return []

    @staticmethod
    def get_all(
        page: int = 1,
        per_page: int = 12,
        category_slug: str = None,
        gender: str = None,
        keyword: str = None,
        admin_mode: bool = False,
    ) -> dict:
        db = ProductModel._db()
        offset = (page - 1) * per_page
        try:
            query = db.table("products").select(
                "*, categories(name, slug), product_variants(*), product_images(*)", count="exact"
            )
            if not admin_mode:
                query = query.is_("deleted_at", "null").eq("is_active", True)

            if category_slug:
                try:
                    cat_res = db.table("categories").select("id").eq("slug", category_slug).limit(1).execute()
                    if cat_res.data:
                        query = query.eq("category_id", cat_res.data[0]["id"])
                    else:
                        return {"items": [], "total": 0, "page": page, "per_page": per_page}
                except Exception as cat_err:
                    logger.error(f"Lỗi resolve category_slug '{category_slug}': {cat_err}")

            if gender:
                query = query.eq("gender", gender)
            if keyword:
                query = query.ilike("name", f"%{keyword}%")

            res = query.order("created_at", desc=True).range(offset, offset + per_page - 1).execute()
            return {
                "items": [ProductModel._format_product(item) for item in (res.data or [])],
                "total": res.count or 0,
                "page": page,
                "per_page": per_page,
            }
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Lỗi get_all products: {e}")
            return {"items": [], "total": 0, "page": page, "per_page": per_page}

    @staticmethod
    def get_by_id(pid: str):
        if not pid:
            return None
        db = ProductModel._db()
        try:
            res = (
                db.table("products")
                .select("*, categories(name, slug), product_images(*), product_variants(*)")
                .eq("id", str(pid).strip())
                .limit(1)
                .execute()
            )
            return ProductModel._format_product(res.data[0]) if res.data else None
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Lỗi get_by_id product '{pid}': {e}")
            return None

    @staticmethod
    def get_by_slug(slug: str):
        if not slug or slug in ("None", "null", "undefined", ""):
            return None
        db = ProductModel._db()
        try:
            res = (
                db.table("products")
                .select("*, categories(name, slug), product_images(*), product_variants(*)")
                .eq("slug", slug)
                .is_("deleted_at", "null")
                .limit(1)
                .execute()
            )
            return ProductModel._format_product(res.data[0]) if res.data else None
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Lỗi get_by_slug '{slug}': {e}")
            return None

    @staticmethod
    def get_by_barcode(barcode: str):
        """Tìm sản phẩm theo mã vạch — dùng trong POS scan."""
        if not barcode:
            return None
        db = ProductModel._db()
        try:
            res = (
                db.table("products")
                .select("*, product_variants(*)")
                .eq("barcode", barcode.strip().upper())
                .is_("deleted_at", "null")
                .limit(1)
                .execute()
            )
            return ProductModel._format_product(res.data[0]) if res.data else None
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Lỗi get_by_barcode '{barcode}': {e}")
            return None

    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    #  WRITE (POST / PUT / DELETE)
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    @staticmethod
    def create(data: dict) -> dict:
        db = ProductModel._db()
        if not data.get("slug") and data.get("name"):
            data["slug"] = ProductModel.generate_slug(data["name"])
        try:
            res = db.table("products").insert(data).execute()
            if not res.data:
                logger.error("[ProductModel.create] Thất bại! Không có dữ liệu trả về. Vui lòng kiểm tra RLS INSERT Policy.")
                return None

            product = res.data[0]
            pid = product["id"]

            barcode = ProductModel.generate_barcode(pid)
            bc_res = db.table("products").update({"barcode": barcode}).eq("id", pid).execute()
            
            if bc_res.data:
                product["barcode"] = barcode
            else:
                logger.warning(f"[ProductModel.create] SP đã tạo nhưng không thể ghi đè Barcode tự động cho ID '{pid}'.")

            return product
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Lỗi tạo sản phẩm: {e}")
            return None

    @staticmethod
    def update(pid: str, data: dict) -> bool:
        """Cập nhật sản phẩm - Tích hợp bộ chặn dữ liệu rác và debug kiểm tra lỗi RLS"""
        if not pid:
            return False
            
        # Làm sạch payload
        if "slug" in data and not data["slug"]:
            data.pop("slug")
        if "thumbnail_url" in data and not data["thumbnail_url"]:
            data.pop("thumbnail_url")
            
        data.pop("barcode", None) # Gỡ bỏ trường không cho phép sửa thông thường
        clean_pid = str(pid).strip()

        try:
            # 🔴 BẬT HỆ THỐNG KIỂM TRA CHỦ ĐỘNG
            print(f"\n=== 🔍 [DEBUG] UPDATE PRODUCT ===")
            print(f"Target ID: '{clean_pid}'")
            print(f"Payload gửi đi: {data}")

            res = ProductModel._db().table("products").update(data).eq("id", clean_pid).execute()
            
            print(f"Mảng trả về từ Supabase: {res.data}")
            
            if not res.data:
                print("🚨 CẢNH BÁO: Supabase trả về mảng rỗng [].")
                print("👉 Nguyên nhân: 1. Sai ID | 2. Bị chặn bởi Policy RLS (Vào Supabase > Bảng products > Tạo Policy cho phép UPDATE).")
                print("=================================\n")
                logger.warning(f"[ProductModel.update] Không tìm thấy dòng hoặc bị RLS chặn tại ID '{clean_pid}'")
                return False
                
            print("✨ Cập nhật thành công vào Database!")
            print("=================================\n")
            return True
            
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Lỗi cập nhật sản phẩm '{pid}': {e}")
            return False

    @staticmethod
    def delete(pid: str, permanent: bool = False) -> bool:
        db = ProductModel._db()
        clean_pid = str(pid).strip()
        try:
            if permanent:
                res = db.table("products").delete().eq("id", clean_pid).execute()
            else:
                res = db.table("products").update({
                    "deleted_at": datetime.now().isoformat(),
                    "is_active": False,
                }).eq("id", clean_pid).execute()
                
            if not res.data:
                logger.warning(f"[ProductModel.delete] Lệnh xóa không tác động lên dòng nào cho ID '{clean_pid}'. Hãy kiểm tra RLS.")
                return False
            return True
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Lỗi xóa sản phẩm '{pid}': {e}")
            return False

    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    #  IMAGES
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    @staticmethod
    def get_images(pid: str) -> list:
        try:
            res = (
                ProductModel._db()
                .table("product_images")
                .select("*")
                .eq("product_id", str(pid).strip())
                .order("sort_order")
                .execute()
            )
            return res.data or []
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Lỗi get_images '{pid}': {e}")
            return []

    @staticmethod
    def sync_images(pid: str, urls: list) -> bool:
        db = ProductModel._db()
        clean_pid = str(pid).strip()
        try:
            db.table("product_images").delete().eq("product_id", clean_pid).execute()
            if urls:
                db.table("product_images").insert([
                    {"product_id": clean_pid, "url": url, "sort_order": i, "is_primary": (i == 0)}
                    for i, url in enumerate(urls)
                ]).execute()
            return True
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Lỗi sync_images '{pid}': {e}")
            return False

    @staticmethod
    def upload_to_storage(file_bytes: bytes, filename: str, content_type: str) -> str:
        db = ProductModel._db()
        try:
            path = f"products/{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}_{filename}"
            db.storage.from_("products").upload(path, file_bytes, {"content-type": content_type})
            return db.storage.from_("products").get_public_url(path)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Lỗi upload storage: {e}")
            return ""
</file>

  .address-item.is-active .radio-dot { transform: scale(1) !important; }

  .payment-item.is-active { border-color: #1c1917 !important; background-color: #f5f5f4 !important; }
  .payment-item.is-active .icon-pay { color: #1c1917 !important; }
  .payment-item.is-active .img-pay { filter: grayscale(0) !important; }

<script>
const Checkout = (() => {
  let currentShippingFee = 0;
  const subtotalAmount = parseInt("{{ total }}") || 0;

  async function calculateShipping(addressId, provinceName) {
    const shipSpan = document.getElementById('shipping-fee');
    shipSpan.innerText = 'Đang tính...';
    shipSpan.className = 'text-white/60';

    try {
      const res = await fetch('/cart/calculate-shipping', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRFToken': '{{ csrf_token() }}' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ province: provinceName, subtotal: subtotalAmount })
      });
      const data = await res.json();

      if(data.success) {
        currentShippingFee = data.shipping_fee;
        updateTotalUI();

        const warningBox = document.getElementById('shipping-warning');
        if (data.warning && data.warning.trim() !== '') {
          warningBox.innerHTML = `
            <i class="fa-solid fa-cloud-bolt text-lg mt-0.5 shrink-0"></i>
            <div>
              <p class="text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest mb-1 text-amber-300">Cảnh báo vận chuyển</p>
              <p class="text-xs font-medium leading-relaxed">${data.warning}</p>
            </div>
          `;
          warningBox.classList.remove('hidden');
        } else {
          warningBox.classList.add('hidden');
        }
      }
    } catch(e) { console.error("Lỗi lấy phí ship", e); }
  }

  function selectAddress(id, provinceName) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.address-item').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('is-active', 'border-stone-900', 'bg-stone-50'));
    document.querySelectorAll('.address-item').forEach(el => el.classList.add('border-stone-100'));
    
    const activeEl = document.getElementById('label-' + id);
    if(activeEl) {
      activeEl.classList.remove('border-stone-100');
      activeEl.classList.add('is-active');
    }
    document.querySelector(`input[value="${id}"]`).checked = true;
    calculateShipping(id, provinceName);
  }

  function selectPayment(method) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.payment-item').forEach(el => {
      el.classList.remove('is-active');
      el.classList.add('border-stone-100');
    });
    
    const activeEl = document.getElementById('pay-' + method.toLowerCase());
    if(activeEl) {
      activeEl.classList.remove('border-stone-100');
      activeEl.classList.add('is-active');
    }
    
    document.querySelector(`input[value="${method}"]`).checked = true;
    document.getElementById('btn-text').innerText = method === 'VNPAY' ? 'Thanh toán qua VNPay' : 'Hoàn tất đặt hàng (COD)';
  }

  function updateTotalUI() {
    const discountText = document.getElementById('discount-amount')?.innerText.replace(/,/g, '') || "0";
    const discount = parseInt(discountText) || 0;

    const shipSpan = document.getElementById('shipping-fee');
    if(currentShippingFee === 0) {
      shipSpan.innerHTML = 'Miễn phí';
      shipSpan.className = 'text-emerald-400 font-bold';
    } else {
      shipSpan.innerHTML = currentShippingFee.toLocaleString('en-US') + ' đ';
      shipSpan.className = 'text-white font-bold'; 
    }

    const final = subtotalAmount - discount + currentShippingFee;
    document.getElementById('final-total').innerText = final.toLocaleString('en-US') + " ₫";
  }

  function handleSubmit(e) {
    const btn  = document.getElementById('btn-submit');
    const text = document.getElementById('btn-text');
    const icon = document.getElementById('btn-icon');
    if (btn.disabled) { e.preventDefault(); return; }
    
    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.classList.add('opacity-70', 'cursor-not-allowed');
    text.innerText = 'Đang xử lý...';
    icon.className = 'fa-solid fa-circle-notch fa-spin';
  }

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    const defaultAddressInput = document.querySelector('input[name="address_id"]:checked');
    if (defaultAddressInput) {
      const province = defaultAddressInput.getAttribute('data-province') || "";
      calculateShipping(defaultAddressInput.value, province);
    }
  });

  return { selectAddress, selectPayment, handleSubmit, updateTotalUI };
})();

const Coupon = (() => {
  const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);

  function setMsg(text, isOk) {
    const el = $('coupon-msg');
    el.innerText = text;
    el.className = `text-[10px] font-bold mt-2 ${isOk ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-red-400'}`;
    el.classList.remove('hidden');
  }

  async function apply() {
    const code = $('coupon-input').value.trim().toUpperCase();
    if (!code) { setMsg('⚠ Vui lòng nhập mã để áp dụng.', false); return; }

    const btn = $('btn-coupon');
    btn.disabled = true; btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-circle-notch fa-spin"></i>';

    try {
      const res  = await fetch('/cart/apply-coupon', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRFToken': '{{ csrf_token() }}' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ code }),
      });
      const data = await res.json();

      if (data.valid) {
        setMsg(`✓ Áp dụng thành công! Giảm ${data.discount.toLocaleString('en-US')}₫`, true);
        $('discount-row').classList.remove('hidden');
        $('coupon-label').innerText = data.code;
        $('discount-amount').innerText = data.discount.toLocaleString('en-US');
        
        Checkout.updateTotalUI();
        
        $('hidden-coupon-code').value = data.code;
        $('coupon-input').disabled = true;
        btn.style.display = 'none';
      } else {
        setMsg(`✕ ${data.error}`, false);
        $('discount-row').classList.add('hidden');
        $('hidden-coupon-code').value = '';
        btn.disabled = false; btn.innerText = 'Áp dụng';
      }
    } catch {
      setMsg('Lỗi kết nối. Vui lòng thử lại.', false);
      btn.disabled = false; btn.innerText = 'Áp dụng';
    }
  }

  return { apply };
})();
</script>
{% endblock %}
</file>

          <button class="sg-tab-btn flex-1 h-12 flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest border border-[#e5e5e5] text-neutral-500 hover:text-black hover:border-black transition-all bg-white" data-target="sg-bottoms">Quần (Bottoms)</button>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {

  /* ==============================
     🎯 ANALYTICS CORE
  ============================== */
  const PRODUCT_ID = "{{ product.id }}";

  function getTrafficSource() {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    return params.get("utm_source") || localStorage.getItem("utm_source") || "organic";
  }

  function trackEvent(eventType, qty = 1) {
    try {
      const payload = JSON.stringify({ product_id: PRODUCT_ID, event_type: eventType, channel: "web", source: getTrafficSource(), qty: qty });
      if (navigator.sendBeacon) { navigator.sendBeacon("/api/analytics/track", new Blob([payload], { type: "application/json" })); } 
      else { fetch("/api/analytics/track", { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: payload }).catch(() => {}); }
    } catch (err) {}
  }
  if (PRODUCT_ID) trackEvent("view");

  const form = document.querySelector('form[action="/cart/add"]');
  if (form) {
    form.addEventListener("submit", () => {
      const qty = parseInt(document.getElementById("qty")?.value || 1);
      trackEvent("cart", qty);
    });
  }

  /* ==============================
     ❤️ WISHLIST
  ============================== */
  const wishlistBtn = document.getElementById("btn-wishlist");
  if (wishlistBtn) {
    wishlistBtn.addEventListener("click", async function() {
      const productId = this.dataset.pid;
      wishlistBtn.disabled = true;
      try {
        const favRes = await fetch('/api/favorites/toggle', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRFToken': '{{ csrf_token() }}' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ product_id: productId })
        });
        const favData = await favRes.json();
        if (favData.status === 'success') {
          if (favData.action === 'added') {
            wishlistBtn.querySelector('svg').setAttribute('fill', 'currentColor');
            wishlistBtn.classList.add('text-red-600');
            trackEvent("wishlist", 1);
          } else {
            wishlistBtn.querySelector('svg').setAttribute('fill', 'none');
            wishlistBtn.classList.remove('text-red-600');
          }
        } else if (favRes.status === 401) {
          alert("Vui lòng đăng nhập!"); window.location.href = "/auth/login";
        }
      } catch (err) {} 
      finally { wishlistBtn.disabled = false; }
    });
  }

  /* ==============================
     🎨 UI & VARIANT LOGIC
  ============================== */
  document.querySelectorAll('.color-swatch').forEach(el => { el.style.backgroundColor = el.dataset.bg; });

  const firstColor = document.querySelector('.color-radio');
  if (firstColor) { firstColor.checked = true; selectColor(firstColor.value); }

  document.querySelectorAll('.color-radio').forEach(radio => {
    radio.addEventListener('change', function() { selectColor(this.value); });
  });

  document.querySelectorAll('.size-radio').forEach(radio => {
    radio.addEventListener('change', function() {
      selectSize(this.dataset.vid, parseInt(this.dataset.stock), parseFloat(this.dataset.price));
    });
  });

  document.querySelectorAll('.btn-qty').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function() { chQty(parseInt(this.dataset.qty)); });
  });

  document.querySelectorAll('.btn-slide').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function() { slide(parseInt(this.dataset.dir)); });
  });

  document.querySelectorAll('.thumbnail-btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function() { goTo(parseInt(this.dataset.index)); });
  });

  /* ==============================
     📐 SIZE GUIDE MODAL TABS
  ============================== */
  const sgTabs = document.querySelectorAll('.sg-tab-btn');
  const sgContents = document.querySelectorAll('.sg-tab-content');

  sgTabs.forEach(tab => {
    tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
      // Đặt lại style các nút
      sgTabs.forEach(t => {
        t.classList.remove('bg-black', 'text-white', 'border-black');
        t.classList.add('bg-white', 'text-neutral-500', 'border-[#e5e5e5]');
      });
      // Bật nút hiện tại
      tab.classList.add('bg-black', 'text-white', 'border-black');
      tab.classList.remove('bg-white', 'text-neutral-500', 'border-[#e5e5e5]');

      // Đổi nội dung hiển thị
      const target = tab.getAttribute('data-target');
      sgContents.forEach(c => {
        c.classList.remove('block');
        c.classList.add('hidden');
        if (c.id === target) {
          c.classList.remove('hidden');
          c.classList.add('block');
        }
      });
    });
  });

});

/* ==============================
   🧠 SELECTOR LOGIC
============================== */
function selectColor(color) {
  document.getElementById('color-label').innerText = color;
  document.querySelectorAll('.size-group').forEach(g => { g.style.display = 'none'; });

  const activeGroup = document.querySelector(`.size-group[data-color="${color}"]`);
  if(activeGroup) {
      activeGroup.style.display = 'flex';
      const firstAvailableSize = activeGroup.querySelector('.size-radio:not([disabled])');

      if (firstAvailableSize) {
          firstAvailableSize.checked = true;
          selectSize(firstAvailableSize.dataset.vid, parseInt(firstAvailableSize.dataset.stock), parseFloat(firstAvailableSize.dataset.price));
      } else {
          disableSubmitState("Sold Out");
      }
  }
}

function selectSize(vid, stock, price) {
  const btn = document.getElementById('btn-submit');
  const status = document.getElementById('stock-status');
  const priceEl = document.getElementById('price-display');
  const originalPriceEl = document.getElementById('price-original');
  const vidInput = document.getElementById('selected-variant-id');
  const qtyInput = document.getElementById('qty');
  const basePrice = parseFloat(priceEl.dataset.basePrice);

  btn.disabled = false;
  btn.innerText = "ADD TO CART";
  btn.className = "flex-1 h-12 bg-black text-white text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] rounded-none hover:bg-[#222] transition-colors flex items-center justify-center border border-black";

  if (stock <= 5) { status.innerHTML = `<span class="text-rose-600">Only ${stock} left in stock</span>`; } 
  else { status.innerHTML = `<span class="text-neutral-500">In Stock</span>`; }

  priceEl.innerText = new Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN').format(price).replace(',','.') + " VND";

  if (price < basePrice) {
      originalPriceEl.innerText = new Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN').format(basePrice).replace(',','.') + " VND";
      originalPriceEl.classList.remove('hidden');
      priceEl.classList.add('text-rose-600');
  } else {
      originalPriceEl.classList.add('hidden');
      priceEl.classList.remove('text-rose-600');
  }

  vidInput.value = vid;
  qtyInput.max = stock;
  if(parseInt(qtyInput.value) > stock) qtyInput.value = stock;
}

function disableSubmitState(message) {
  const btn = document.getElementById('btn-submit');
  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.innerText = "SOLD OUT";
  btn.className = "flex-1 h-12 bg-[#e5e5e5] text-neutral-500 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] rounded-none cursor-not-allowed flex items-center justify-center border border-transparent";

  document.getElementById('selected-variant-id').value = '';
  document.getElementById('stock-status').innerHTML = `<span class="text-rose-600">${message}</span>`;
  document.getElementById('price-original').classList.add('hidden');
  document.getElementById('price-display').classList.remove('text-rose-600');
}

function chQty(d) {
  const el = document.getElementById('qty');
  const maxStock = parseInt(el.max) || 1;
  let v = parseInt(el.value) + d;
  if (v < 1) v = 1;
  if (v > maxStock) v = maxStock;
  el.value = v;
}

/* ==============================
   🎞 CAROUSEL
============================== */
const slides = document.querySelectorAll('.carousel-slide');
let current = 0;

function goTo(n) {
  if (slides.length <= 1) return;
  slides[current].style.opacity = '0';
  slides[current].style.zIndex = '0';
  
  current = (n + slides.length) % slides.length;
  
  slides[current].style.opacity = '1';
  slides[current].style.zIndex = '10';

  document.querySelectorAll('.thumbnail-btn').forEach((b, i) => {
    b.classList.toggle('opacity-100', i === current);
    b.classList.toggle('opacity-50', i !== current);
    b.classList.toggle('border-black', i === current);
    b.classList.toggle('border-transparent', i !== current);
  });
}
function slide(d) { goTo(current + d); }

/* ==============================
   👇 ACCORDION & MODALS
============================== */
window.toggleAccordion = function(id) {
  const content = document.getElementById(id);
  const icon = document.getElementById('icon-' + id);
  if (content.classList.contains('open')) {
    content.classList.remove('open');
    icon.classList.remove('open');
  } else {
    content.classList.add('open');
    icon.classList.add('open');
  }
}

function openSizeGuide() {
  const modal = document.getElementById('sizeGuideModal');
  const content = document.getElementById('sgContent');
  modal.classList.remove('hidden');
  modal.classList.add('flex');
  setTimeout(() => {
    modal.classList.replace('opacity-0', 'opacity-100');
    content.classList.replace('scale-95', 'scale-100');
  }, 10);
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
}

function closeSizeGuide() {
  const modal = document.getElementById('sizeGuideModal');
  const content = document.getElementById('sgContent');
  modal.classList.replace('opacity-100', 'opacity-0');
  content.classList.replace('scale-100', 'scale-95');
  setTimeout(() => {
    modal.classList.remove('flex');
    modal.classList.add('hidden');
  }, 300);
  document.body.style.overflow = '';
}

def create_app() -> Flask:
    # ĐỔI TÊN BIẾN THÀNH flask_app ĐỂ IDE KHÔNG BỊ NHẦM
    flask_app = Flask(__name__, template_folder="templates", static_folder="static")

    # 1. Validate & Load Config
    validate_config()
    flask_app.config.from_object(get_config())
    flask_app.config["BASE_URL"] = os.environ.get("BASE_URL", "")
    # 2. Extensions
    csrf.init_app(flask_app)

    # 3. Blueprints
    from app.controllers.auth_controller                               import auth_bp
    from app.controllers.product_controller                            import products_bp
    from app.controllers.cart_controller                               import cart_bp
    from app.controllers.admin                                         import admin_bp
    from app.controllers.profile_controller                            import profile_bp
    from app.controllers.chat_controller                               import chat_bp
    from app.controllers.ai_controller                                 import ai_bp
    from app.controllers.favorite_controller                           import favorite_bp
    from app.controllers.payment_controller                            import payment_bp
    from app.controllers.admin.admin_shipping_controller               import admin_shipping_bp
    from app.controllers.admin.admin_shipping_providers_controller     import admin_providers_bp
    from app.controllers.promotions_controller                         import promotions_bp
    from app.controllers.analytics_controller                          import analytics_bp
    from app.controllers.notification_controller                      import notification_bp

    try:
        import app.controllers.admin.settings
    except ImportError as e:
        logger.warning(f"Chưa load được settings controller: {e}")

    for bp in [
        auth_bp, products_bp, cart_bp, admin_bp,
        profile_bp, chat_bp, ai_bp, favorite_bp, payment_bp,
        admin_shipping_bp, admin_providers_bp, promotions_bp, analytics_bp, notification_bp
    ]:
        flask_app.register_blueprint(bp)

    if flask_app.config.get("DEBUG"):
        from app.controllers.debug_controller import debug_bp
        flask_app.register_blueprint(debug_bp)
        logger.info("🛠️  Debug blueprint đã được kích hoạt (Development only).")

    # 4. Context Processor
    @flask_app.context_processor
    def inject_globals() -> dict:
        cart_count = 0
        categories = []
        pending_returns = 0
        system_settings = {}
        
        user_id = session.get("user_id")
        role = session.get("role")

        try:
            system_settings = SettingModel.get_settings()
        except Exception:
            logger.warning("context_processor: Lỗi khi lấy system_settings.")

        unread_notification_count = 0
        if user_id:
            try:
                cart_count = CartModel.get_count(user_id)
            except Exception:
                pass
            try:
                from app.models.notification_model import NotificationModel
                unread_notification_count = NotificationModel.get_unread_count(user_id)
            except Exception:
                pass

        try:
            categories = CategoryModel.get_all()
        except Exception:
            pass

        if role == "admin":
            try:
                from app.utils.supabase_client import get_supabase
                r = (
                    get_supabase()
                    .table("return_requests")
                    .select("id", count="exact")
                    .eq("status", "pending")
                    .execute()
                )
                pending_returns = r.count or 0
            except Exception:
                pass

        return {
            "current_user": {
                "id": user_id,
                "email": session.get("email"),
                "full_name": session.get("full_name"),
                "role": role,
            },
            "cart_count": cart_count,
            "global_categories": categories,
            "pending_returns": pending_returns,
            "system_settings": system_settings,
            "unread_notification_count": unread_notification_count,
        }

    # 5. Error Handlers
    def _error_response(code: int, title: str, desc: str):
        show_debug = flask_app.config.get("DEBUG", False)
        return render_template_string(
            ERROR_TEMPLATE, code=code, title=title, desc=desc,
            show_debug=show_debug
        ), code

    @flask_app.errorhandler(400)
    def bad_request(_e):
        return _error_response(400, "Yêu cầu không hợp lệ", "Dữ liệu gửi lên bị lỗi hoặc không đúng định dạng.")

    @flask_app.errorhandler(403)
    def forbidden(_e):
        return _error_response(403, "Từ chối truy cập", "Bạn không có quyền truy cập vào trang này.")

    @flask_app.errorhandler(CSRFError)
    def handle_csrf_error(_e):
        return _error_response(403, "Phiên bảo mật hết hạn", "Token bảo mật đã hết hạn. Vui lòng tải lại trang và thử lại.")

    @flask_app.errorhandler(404)
    def not_found(_e):
        return _error_response(404, "Không tìm thấy trang", "Đường dẫn này không tồn tại hoặc đã bị gỡ khỏi hệ thống GUA Maison.")

    @flask_app.errorhandler(405)
    def method_not_allowed(_e):
        return _error_response(405, "Phương thức không được phép", "Hành động này không được hỗ trợ trên endpoint hiện tại.")

    @flask_app.errorhandler(413)
    def request_too_large(_e):
        return _error_response(413, "File quá lớn", "Kích thước file vượt quá giới hạn 10 MB. Vui lòng chọn ảnh nhỏ hơn.")

    @flask_app.errorhandler(500)
    def server_error(_e):
        logger.exception("Internal Server Error")
        return _error_response(500, "Lỗi máy chủ", "Hệ thống đang gặp sự cố kỹ thuật. Đội ngũ kỹ sư đang xử lý.")

    return flask_app
</file>

<script>
  const MobileMenu = {
    panel: document.getElementById('mobilePanel'), backdrop: document.getElementById('mobileBackdrop'), btn: document.getElementById('hamburgerBtn'),
    open() {
      this.panel.classList.replace('translate-x-full', 'translate-x-0');
      this.backdrop.classList.remove('opacity-0', 'pointer-events-none'); this.backdrop.classList.add('opacity-100');
      this.btn.classList.add('is-open'); document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    },
    close() {
      this.panel.classList.replace('translate-x-0', 'translate-x-full');
      this.backdrop.classList.add('opacity-0', 'pointer-events-none'); this.backdrop.classList.remove('opacity-100');
      this.btn.classList.remove('is-open'); document.body.style.overflow = '';
    },
    toggle() { this.panel.classList.contains('translate-x-0') ? this.close() : this.open(); }
  };

  const Progress = (() => {
    const bar = document.getElementById('nprogress'); let timer;
    return {
      start() {
        clearTimeout(timer); bar.style.transition = 'none'; bar.style.width = '0%';
        requestAnimationFrame(() => { bar.style.transition = 'width 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)'; bar.style.width = '70%'; });
      },
      done() {
        bar.style.transition = 'width 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)'; bar.style.width = '100%';
        timer = setTimeout(() => {
          bar.style.transition = 'opacity 0.3s ease'; bar.style.opacity = '0';
          setTimeout(() => { bar.style.width = '0'; bar.style.opacity = '1'; }, 350);
        }, 200);
      }
    };
  })();

  document.querySelectorAll('a[data-nav]').forEach(a => {
    a.addEventListener('click', e => {
      const href = a.getAttribute('href');
      if (!href || href.startsWith('#') || a.target === '_blank') return;
      Progress.start();
    });
  });

  window.addEventListener('pageshow', () => Progress.done());
  window.addEventListener('load', () => Progress.done());

  const nav = document.getElementById('adminNav');
  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    if (window.scrollY > 10) {
      nav.classList.add('shadow-md', 'border-transparent', 'bg-white/95');
      nav.classList.remove('border-stone-200/80', 'bg-white/85');
    } else {
      nav.classList.remove('shadow-md', 'border-transparent', 'bg-white/95');
      nav.classList.add('border-stone-200/80', 'bg-white/85');
    }
  }, { passive: true });
</script>
</file>

<script>
(function(){
  /* ══ Barcode Logic ══════════════════════════════════════════ */
  const BARCODE_VALUE = "{{ product.barcode if product and product.barcode else '' }}";

  function renderBarcode(code) {
    try {
      JsBarcode("#barcodePreview", code, {
        format: "CODE128", width: 1.8, height: 50, displayValue: false, 
        background: "transparent", lineColor: "#1c1917", margin: 0,
      });
      document.getElementById('barcodeText').textContent = code;
    } catch(e) { console.warn('JsBarcode error:', e); }
  }

  if (BARCODE_VALUE) {
    renderBarcode(BARCODE_VALUE);
  } else {
    const nameInput = document.getElementById('prod_name');
    function renderPreview() {
      const name = nameInput.value.trim();
      const preview = name ? 'GUA-' + name.replace(/\s+/g, '').slice(0,6).toUpperCase() : 'GUA-PREVIEW';
      renderBarcode(preview);
    }
    nameInput.addEventListener('input', renderPreview);
    renderPreview();
  }

  window.printBarcode = function() {
    const svg = document.getElementById('barcodePreview');
    const label = document.getElementById('barcodeText').textContent;
    const svgData = new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(svg);
    const html = `<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="UTF-8">
<style>@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:wght@400;700&display=swap');@page{margin:0}body{margin:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:100vh;background:#fff;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif}.wrap{text-align:center;padding:20mm 14mm;border:1px dashed #ccc;display:inline-block}.brand{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:8px;color:#1c1917}svg{display:block;margin:0 auto}.code{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.15em;font-family:monospace;margin-top:10px;color:#1c1917}</style></head><body>
<div class="wrap"><div class="brand">GUA MAISON</div>${svgData}<div class="code">${label}</div></div>
<script>window.onload=()=>{window.print();setTimeout(()=>window.close(),500)}<\/script></body></html>`;
    const w = window.open('','_blank','width=420,height=320');
    w.document.open(); w.document.write(html); w.document.close();
  };

  window.downloadBarcode = function() {
    const svg = document.getElementById('barcodePreview');
    const label = document.getElementById('barcodeText').textContent;
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    const padding = 24; const svgW = svg.width?.baseVal?.value || 200; const svgH = svg.height?.baseVal?.value || 60;
    canvas.width = svgW + padding * 2; canvas.height = svgH + padding * 2 + 24;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    const img = new Image();
    const svgBlob = new Blob([new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(svg)], {type:'image/svg+xml'});
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(svgBlob);
    img.onload = function() {
      ctx.drawImage(img, padding, padding);
      ctx.font = 'bold 12px monospace'; ctx.fillStyle = '#1c1917'; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.letterSpacing = '0.1em';
      ctx.fillText(label, canvas.width / 2, svgH + padding + 18);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      const a = document.createElement('a'); a.download = `barcode-${label}.png`; a.href = canvas.toDataURL('image/png'); a.click();
    };
    img.src = url;
  };

  /* ══ Variant Logic ══════════════════════════════════════════ */
  const SIZES=['XS','S','M','L','XL','XXL','38','39','40','41','42','43'];
  const COLORS=[
    {n:'Đen',h:'#1c1917'},{n:'Trắng',h:'#fafaf9'},{n:'Xám',h:'#78716c'},{n:'Đỏ',h:'#ef4444'},
    {n:'Xanh dương',h:'#3b82f6'},{n:'Xanh navy',h:'#1e3a8a'},{n:'Xanh lá',h:'#22c55e'},
    {n:'Vàng',h:'#eab308'},{n:'Nâu',h:'#78350f'},{n:'Hồng',h:'#ec4899'},{n:'Tím',h:'#d946ef'},
    {n:'Cam',h:'#f97316'},{n:'Be',h:'#f5f5dc'},{n:'Kem',h:'#fef3c7'}
  ];

  let groups = [];
  const raw = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('pdata').textContent);

  if (raw.length) {
    raw.forEach(v => {
      let g = groups.find(g => g.cn === v.color_name && g.ch === v.color_hex);
      if (!g) { g = {cn: v.color_name, ch: v.color_hex, sz: []}; groups.push(g); }
      g.sz.push({s: v.size, k: v.stock, p: v.price_override || ''});
    });
  } else {
    groups.push({cn: '', ch: '#1c1917', sz: []});
  }

  function render() {
    const bp = document.getElementById('base_price').value;
    const ph = bp ? `Mặc định: ${(+bp).toLocaleString('vi-VN')}đ` : 'Bằng giá niêm yết';
    const c = document.getElementById('vgc');
    
    c.innerHTML = groups.map((g, gi) => {
      const chips = SIZES.map(s => {
        const on = g.sz.some(z => z.s === s);
        const cls = on ? 'bg-black text-white border-black' : 'bg-white text-stone-500 border-stone-200 hover:border-black hover:text-black';
        return `<button type="button" class="h-9 px-4 rounded-xl border text-[11px] font-bold transition-all shadow-sm ${cls}" onclick="tSz(${gi},'${s}')">${s}</button>`;
      }).join('');
      
      const rows = g.sz.length ? `
        <div class="mt-5 border-t border-stone-100 pt-5 space-y-3">
            <div class="grid grid-cols-[60px_1fr_1fr_36px] gap-3 px-2 text-[10px] font-bold text-stone-400 uppercase tracking-widest">
                <div>Size</div><div>Tồn kho *</div><div>Giá bán lẻ (Tuỳ chọn)</div><div></div>
            </div>
            ${g.sz.map((z, zi) => `
            <div class="grid grid-cols-[60px_1fr_1fr_36px] gap-3 items-center">
              <input type="hidden" name="v_color[]" value="${g.cn}">
              <input type="hidden" name="v_color_hex[]" value="${g.ch}">
              <input type="hidden" name="v_size[]" value="${z.s}">
              <div class="h-11 bg-stone-100 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs text-stone-700">${z.s}</div>
              <input type="number" name="v_stock[]" value="${z.k}" min="0" required placeholder="0" class="h-11 w-full bg-stone-50 border border-stone-200 rounded-xl px-4 text-sm font-semibold focus:bg-white focus:border-black focus:outline-none transition-colors" onchange="upSz(${gi},${zi},'k',this.value)">
              <input type="number" name="v_price_override[]" value="${z.p}" placeholder="${ph}" class="h-11 w-full bg-stone-50 border border-stone-200 rounded-xl px-4 text-sm font-medium focus:bg-white focus:border-black focus:outline-none transition-colors" onchange="upSz(${gi},${zi},'p',this.value)">
              <button type="button" class="h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-stone-200 text-stone-400 hover:text-rose-600 hover:border-rose-200 hover:bg-rose-50 transition-colors flex items-center justify-center" onclick="tSz(${gi},'${z.s}')"><i class="fa-solid fa-trash-can text-sm"></i></button>
            </div>`).join('')}
        </div>` : '';

      return `
        <div class="bg-stone-50/50 border border-stone-200 rounded-[1.5rem] p-5 relative group/vg transition-all hover:border-stone-300 hover:shadow-sm">
          ${groups.length > 1 ? `<button type="button" class="absolute top-4 right-4 text-xs font-semibold text-rose-500 bg-rose-50 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg opacity-0 group-hover/vg:opacity-100 transition-opacity hover:bg-rose-600 hover:text-white" onclick="rmGrp(${gi})">Xóa nhóm</button>` : ''}
          
          <div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
            <div>
              <p class="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-stone-500 mb-3">1. Định danh màu <span class="text-red-500">*</span></p>
              <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                <label class="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl border-2 border-white shadow-[0_0_0_1px_#e7e5e4] shrink-0 cursor-pointer overflow-hidden transition-transform hover:scale-105" style="background:${g.ch}">
                  <input type="color" class="opacity-0 w-full h-full cursor-pointer" value="${g.ch}" onchange="upGrp(${gi},'ch',this.value)">
                </label>
                <div class="relative w-full">
                  <input type="text" class="w-full bg-white border border-stone-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium focus:outline-none focus:border-black transition-colors" value="${g.cn}" required placeholder="VD: Đen" oninput="suggest(this,${gi})" onchange="upGrp(${gi},'cn',this.value)">
                  <div id="sg${gi}" class="suggest-box"></div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            
            <div>
              <p class="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-stone-500 mb-3">2. Kích thước (Bấm chọn)</p>
              <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                ${chips}
                <div class="flex items-center bg-white border border-stone-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden h-9 shadow-sm focus-within:border-black transition-colors">
                  <input id="cs${gi}" placeholder="Khác..." class="w-16 px-3 text-xs font-semibold bg-transparent outline-none" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter'){event.preventDefault();cSz(${gi})}">
                  <button type="button" class="px-3 bg-stone-50 hover:bg-stone-200 text-stone-600 border-l border-stone-200 transition-colors" onclick="cSz(${gi})"><i class="fa-solid fa-plus text-xs"></i></button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          ${rows}
        </div>`;
    }).join('');
  }

  window.addGroup = () => { groups.push({cn:'',ch:'#1c1917',sz:[]}); render(); };
  window.rmGrp   = i  => { groups.splice(i,1); if(!groups.length) addGroup(); else render(); };
  window.tSz     = (gi,s) => { const g=groups[gi],i=g.sz.findIndex(z=>z.s===s); i>=0?g.sz.splice(i,1):g.sz.push({s,k:0,p:''}); render(); };
  window.cSz     = gi => { const el=document.getElementById(`cs${gi}`),v=el.value.trim().toUpperCase(); if(v&&v.length<=6){tSz(gi,v)}; };
  window.upGrp   = (gi,k,v) => { groups[gi][k]=v; render(); };
  window.upSz    = (gi,si,k,v) => { groups[gi].sz[si][k]=v; };
  window.syncPricePlaceholder = () => render();

  window.suggest = (el, gi) => {
    const q=el.value.toLowerCase().trim(), box=document.getElementById(`sg${gi}`);
    if(!q){box.style.display='none';return}
    const m=COLORS.filter(c=>c.n.toLowerCase().includes(q)).slice(0,5);
    if(!m.length){box.style.display='none';return}
    box.innerHTML=m.map(c=>`<div class="suggest-item" onclick="pick(${gi},'${c.h}','${c.n}')"><div class="w-4 h-4 rounded-full border border-stone-200 shrink-0" style="background:${c.h}"></div><span class="text-sm font-semibold text-stone-700">${c.n}</span></div>`).join('');
    box.style.display='block';
  };
  window.pick = (gi,h,n) => { groups[gi].ch=h; groups[gi].cn=n; render(); };
  document.addEventListener('click', e => {
    if(!e.target.closest('.suggest-box')&&!e.target.closest('input'))
      document.querySelectorAll('.suggest-box').forEach(b=>b.style.display='none');
  });

  /* ══ 🔴 BẢN CẬP NHẬT: Image Logic (Kéo thả & Tải lên bất đồng bộ) ════ */
  
  // Hàm gán nhãn "Ảnh bìa" động cho thẻ đầu tiên
  function updateCoverBadge() {
    document.querySelectorAll('#imgGrid .img-cover').forEach(el => el.remove());
    const firstCard = document.querySelector('#imgGrid .img-card');
    if (firstCard) {
      const b = document.createElement('div');
      b.className = 'absolute bottom-0 inset-x-0 bg-black/70 text-white text-[8px] font-bold text-center py-1 uppercase tracking-widest img-cover pointer-events-none';
      b.textContent = 'Ảnh bìa';
      firstCard.appendChild(b);
    }
  }

  // Khởi tạo kéo thả SortableJS cho khung ảnh
  new Sortable(document.getElementById('imgGrid'), {
    animation: 200,
    ghostClass: 'sortable-ghost',
    onEnd: function() {
      updateCoverBadge();
      setSync();
    }
  });

  // Tải ảnh trực tiếp lên Supabase ngay khi chọn file từ thiết bị
  window.handleFiles = inp => {
    const token = document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]')?.getAttribute('content') || document.querySelector('input[name="csrf_token"]')?.value;
    
    Array.from(inp.files).forEach(f => {
      // 1. Tạo block placeholder "Đang tải..." tạm thời vào lưới
      const g = document.getElementById('imgGrid');
      const d = document.createElement('div');
      d.className = 'relative aspect-[3/4] rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-stone-200 shadow-sm bg-stone-50 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1.5 loading-placeholder animate-pulse';
      d.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-circle-notch fa-spin text-stone-400 text-lg"></i><span class="text-[10px] text-stone-400 font-bold">Đang tải...</span>`;
      g.appendChild(d);
      updateCoverBadge();

      // 2. Đẩy file bất đồng bộ lên endpoint mới thiết lập
      const fd = new FormData();
      fd.append('file', f);

      fetch("{{ url_for('admin.upload_product_image_async') }}", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "X-CSRFToken": token },
        body: fd
      })
      .then(res => {
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error();
        return res.json();
      })
      .then(data => {
        if (data.url) {
          // 3. Hoàn thành: Thay đổi giao diện placeholder thành thẻ ảnh thật
          d.className = 'relative aspect-[3/4] rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-stone-100 group shadow-sm bg-stone-50 img-card cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing';
          d.innerHTML = `
            <img src="${data.url}" class="w-full h-full object-cover">
            <input type="hidden" name="image_urls" value="${data.url}">
            <button type="button" onclick="removeImg(this)" class="absolute top-1 right-1 w-6 h-6 bg-white/90 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-rose-600 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity hover:bg-rose-600 hover:text-white">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-xmark text-[10px]"></i>
            </button>
          `;
          updateCoverBadge();
          setSync();
        } else {
          d.remove();
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {
        d.remove();
        alert(`Gặp lỗi khi tải lên tệp tin: ${f.name}`);
      });
    });
    inp.value = ''; // Reset input để chọn lại file cũ được nếu muốn
  };

  window.addUrl = () => {
    const i = document.getElementById('urlInput'), u = i.value.trim();
    if (!u || !u.startsWith('http')) return;
    
    const g = document.getElementById('imgGrid');
    const d = document.createElement('div');
    d.className = 'relative aspect-[3/4] rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-stone-100 group shadow-sm bg-stone-50 img-card cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing';
    d.innerHTML = `
      <img src="${u}" class="w-full h-full object-cover">
      <input type="hidden" name="image_urls" value="${u}">
      <button type="button" onclick="removeImg(this)" class="absolute top-1 right-1 w-6 h-6 bg-white/90 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-rose-600 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity hover:bg-rose-600 hover:text-white">
        <i class="fa-solid fa-xmark text-[10px]"></i>
      </button>
    `;
    g.appendChild(d);
    i.value = '';
    updateCoverBadge();
    setSync();
  };

  window.removeImg = btn => {
    btn.closest('.img-card').remove();
    updateCoverBadge();
    setSync();
  };

  function setSync() { document.getElementById('imgSync').value = '1'; }

  /* ══ Form Validation ══════════════════════════════════════ */
  document.getElementById('productForm').onsubmit = function(e) {
    const bp = document.getElementById('base_price'), err = document.getElementById('price-error');
    if (!bp.value || +bp.value <= 0) {
        e.preventDefault(); err.classList.remove('hidden'); bp.classList.add('border-red-500', 'bg-red-50'); bp.focus(); return false;
    }
    if (!groups.some(g => g.sz.length)) {
        e.preventDefault(); alert('⚠ Vui lòng chọn ít nhất 1 kích thước cho sản phẩm!'); return false;
    }
    const btn = document.getElementById('btn-save-main');
    btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-circle-notch fa-spin"></i> Đang xử lý...';
    btn.classList.add('opacity-70', 'cursor-not-allowed');
    return true;
  };

  render();
})();
</script>
{% endblock %}
</file>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {

    /* ── 0. Apply funnel bar widths from data-* attributes ── */
    document.querySelectorAll('.funnel-bar').forEach(bar => {
        const pct = parseFloat(bar.dataset.width) || 0;
        bar.style.width = Math.min(Math.max(pct, 0), 100) + '%';
    });

    /* ── 1. Parse chart data ── */
    let data = { monthly: [], channel: {} };
    try {
        data = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('chart-data').textContent);
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('chart-data parse error:', e);
    }

    /* ── 2. Global Chart.js defaults ── */
    Chart.defaults.font.family = "'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif";
    Chart.defaults.color = '#94a3b8';

    const CHART_COLORS = [
        '#6366f1', // indigo-500
        '#10b981', // emerald-500
        '#3b82f6', // blue-500
        '#f59e0b', // amber-500
        '#8b5cf6', // violet-500
        '#f43f5e'  // rose-500
    ];

    const CHANNEL_LABEL_MAP = {
        web:    'Website',
        pos:    'Tại Cửa Hàng',
        tiktok: 'TikTok Shop',
        shopee: 'Shopee'
    };

    /* ── 3. Doughnut — Tỉ trọng kênh ── */
    const pieCanvas = document.getElementById('channelPieChart');
    const channelKeys    = Object.keys(data.channel);
    const channelValues  = Object.values(data.channel);
    const channelLabels  = channelKeys.map(k => CHANNEL_LABEL_MAP[k] || k.toUpperCase());

    if (pieCanvas && channelLabels.length > 0) {
        new Chart(pieCanvas, {
            type: 'doughnut',
            data: {
                labels: channelLabels,
                datasets: [{
                    data: channelValues,
                    backgroundColor: CHART_COLORS.slice(0, channelLabels.length),
                    borderWidth: 4,
                    borderColor: '#ffffff',
                    borderRadius: 4,
                    hoverOffset: 6
                }]
            },
            options: {
                responsive: true,
                maintainAspectRatio: false,
                cutout: '75%',
                plugins: {
                    legend: {
                        position: 'bottom',
                        labels: {
                            usePointStyle: true,
                            pointStyle: 'circle',
                            padding: 20,
                            font: { size: 12, weight: '500' },
                            color: '#64748b'
                        }
                    },
                    tooltip: {
                        padding: 12,
                        cornerRadius: 8,
                        backgroundColor: '#0f172a',
                        bodyFont: { size: 13, weight: 'bold' },
                        callbacks: {
                            label: ctx => ' ' + Number(ctx.raw).toLocaleString('vi-VN') + ' ₫'
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    }

    /* ── 4. Line — Tăng trưởng 12 tháng ── */
    const lineCanvas = document.getElementById('monthlyRevenueChart');

    if (lineCanvas && data.monthly && data.monthly.length > 0) {
        const ctx = lineCanvas.getContext('2d');

        const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 400);
        gradient.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.2)');
        gradient.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(99, 102, 241, 0)');

        new Chart(lineCanvas, {
            type: 'line',
            data: {
                labels: data.monthly.map(d => d.month),
                datasets: [{
                    label: 'Doanh thu',
                    data: data.monthly.map(d => d.revenue),
                    borderColor: '#6366f1',
                    backgroundColor: gradient,
                    borderWidth: 3,
                    tension: 0.4,
                    fill: true,
                    pointRadius: 4,
                    pointBackgroundColor: '#ffffff',
                    pointBorderColor: '#6366f1',
                    pointBorderWidth: 2,
                    pointHoverRadius: 6,
                    pointHoverBackgroundColor: '#6366f1'
                }]
            },
            options: {
                responsive: true,
                maintainAspectRatio: false,
                interaction: { mode: 'index', intersect: false },
                plugins: {
                    legend: { display: false },
                    tooltip: {
                        backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
                        titleColor: '#64748b',
                        bodyColor: '#0f172a',
                        borderColor: '#e2e8f0',
                        borderWidth: 1,
                        titleFont: { size: 12, weight: '500' },
                        bodyFont: { size: 14, weight: 'bold' },
                        padding: 12,
                        cornerRadius: 12,
                        displayColors: false,
                        callbacks: {
                            label: ctx => Number(ctx.raw).toLocaleString('vi-VN') + ' ₫'
                        }
                        /* NOTE: boxShadow is NOT a valid Chart.js tooltip option — removed */
                    }
                },
                scales: {
                    y: {
                        border: { display: false },
                        grid: { color: '#f1f5f9', drawTicks: false },
                        ticks: {
                            callback: v => (v / 1_000_000).toLocaleString('vi-VN') + ' Tr',
                            padding: 12,
                            font: { size: 11, weight: '500' },
                            color: '#94a3b8'
                        }
                    },
                    x: {
                        border: { display: false },
                        grid: { display: false },
                        ticks: {
                            font: { size: 11, weight: '500' },
                            color: '#94a3b8',
                            padding: 12
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    }
});
</script>

  <script>
  // Chuyển đổi View dạng Grid / Table
  function setView(v) {
    const t = document.getElementById('view-table'), g = document.getElementById('view-grid');
    const bt = document.getElementById('btn-table'), bg = document.getElementById('btn-grid');
    
    if (v === 'grid') {
      t.classList.add('hidden'); g.classList.remove('hidden');
      bg.classList.add('bg-white', 'text-stone-900', 'shadow-sm', 'border', 'border-stone-200'); bg.classList.remove('text-stone-400');
      bt.classList.remove('bg-white', 'text-stone-900', 'shadow-sm', 'border', 'border-stone-200'); bt.classList.add('text-stone-400');
    } else {
      g.classList.add('hidden'); t.classList.remove('hidden');
      bt.classList.add('bg-white', 'text-stone-900', 'shadow-sm', 'border', 'border-stone-200'); bt.classList.remove('text-stone-400');
      bg.classList.remove('bg-white', 'text-stone-900', 'shadow-sm', 'border', 'border-stone-200'); bg.classList.add('text-stone-400');
    }
    localStorage.setItem('productViewStyle', v);
  }

  if (localStorage.getItem('productViewStyle') === 'grid') { setView('grid'); } else { setView('table'); }

  // Khởi tạo Barcode
  let _currentBarcode = '';
  const popup = document.getElementById('barcode-popup');

  function renderAllMiniBarcodes() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.bc-svg-mini[data-barcode]').forEach(svg => {
      const code = svg.getAttribute('data-barcode');
      if (!code) return;
      try {
        JsBarcode(svg, code, {
          format: 'CODE128', width: 1.4, height: 32,
          displayValue: false, margin: 0, background: 'transparent', lineColor: '#1c1917',
        });
      } catch(e) { svg.closest('.bc-inline')?.remove(); }
    });
  }

  function showBarcodePopup(triggerEl, code) {
    _currentBarcode = code;
    const svgEl = document.getElementById('bc-popup-svg');
    try {
      JsBarcode(svgEl, code, {
        format: 'CODE128', width: 2, height: 60, displayValue: false,
        margin: 4, background: '#ffffff', lineColor: '#1c1917',
      });
    } catch(e) { return; }

    document.getElementById('bc-popup-label').textContent = code;
    const rect = triggerEl.getBoundingClientRect();
    popup.style.display = 'block';
    
    // Animation reflow
    void popup.offsetWidth;
    
    const pw = popup.offsetWidth || 260;
    const ph = popup.offsetHeight || 180;
    let top = rect.bottom + 12;
    let left = rect.left;

    if (top + ph > window.innerHeight - 16) top = rect.top - ph - 12;
    if (left + pw > window.innerWidth - 16) left = window.innerWidth - pw - 16;
    if (left < 16) left = 16;

    popup.style.top = top + 'px';
    popup.style.left = left + 'px';
    popup.classList.add('visible');
    popup.style.pointerEvents = 'all';
  }

  function closeBarcodePopup() {
    popup.classList.remove('visible');
    setTimeout(() => {
      if(!popup.classList.contains('visible')) {
          popup.style.display = 'none';
          popup.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
      }
    }, 200);
  }

  function copyBarcode() {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(_currentBarcode).then(() => {
      const btn = popup.querySelector('.bc-btn:not(.print)');
      const orig = btn.innerHTML;
      btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-check text-emerald-600"></i> Đã copy';
      setTimeout(() => btn.innerHTML = orig, 1500);
    }).catch(() => {});
  }

  function printBarcode() {
    const printSvg = document.getElementById('bc-print-svg');
    const printLabel = document.getElementById('bc-print-label');
    try {
      JsBarcode(printSvg, _currentBarcode, {
        format: 'CODE128', width: 3, height: 80, displayValue: true,
        text: _currentBarcode, fontSize: 14, margin: 8, background: '#ffffff', lineColor: '#000000',
      });
    } catch(e) { return; }
    printLabel.textContent = _currentBarcode;

    const area = document.getElementById('barcode-print-area');
    area.style.display = 'flex';
    window.print();
    area.style.display = 'none';
  }

  document.addEventListener('click', e => {
    if (!popup.contains(e.target) && !e.target.closest('[onclick*="showBarcodePopup"]')) {
      closeBarcodePopup();
    }
  });
  window.addEventListener('scroll', closeBarcodePopup, { passive: true });
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', renderAllMiniBarcodes);
  </script>
  {% endblock %}
</file>

  <script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {

      // Đo chiều cao navbar thực tế -> set CSS variable --header-h
      const navbar = document.querySelector('nav, header, [data-navbar]');
      if (navbar) {
        const setHeaderH = () => document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--header-h', navbar.offsetHeight + 'px');
        setHeaderH();
        new ResizeObserver(setHeaderH).observe(navbar);
      }

      // Mobile menu toggle
      const openBtn = document.getElementById('openMenu');
      const closeBtn = document.getElementById('closeMenu');
      const menu    = document.getElementById('mobileMenu');
      if (openBtn && closeBtn && menu) {
        const toggleMenu = (show) => {
          menu.classList.toggle('invisible', !show);
          menu.classList.toggle('opacity-0', !show);
          menu.classList.toggle('opacity-100', show);
          openBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', show);
          document.body.style.overflow = show ? 'hidden' : '';
        };
        openBtn.addEventListener('click', () => toggleMenu(true));
        closeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => toggleMenu(false));
      }

      // Scroll reveal
      const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach(entry => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            entry.target.classList.add('active');
            observer.unobserve(entry.target);
          }
        });
      }, { threshold: 0.08 });
      document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
    });

    // CSRF helper
    function getCSRFToken() {
      return document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]')?.getAttribute('content') || '';
    }

    // Analytics tracking
    function trackEvent(data) {
      fetch('/api/analytics/track', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRFToken': getCSRFToken() },
        body: JSON.stringify(data)
      }).catch(() => {});
    }

    // Toast notification
    let toastContainer = null;
    function showToast(msg, isError = false) {
      if (!toastContainer) {
        toastContainer = Object.assign(document.createElement('div'), {
          className: 'fixed bottom-8 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-[9999] flex flex-col gap-2 pointer-events-none'
        });
        document.body.appendChild(toastContainer);
      }
      const toast = Object.assign(document.createElement('div'), {
        className: `bg-white text-black px-6 py-3 flex items-center gap-3 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest shadow-lg border transition-all duration-300 translate-y-4 opacity-0 pointer-events-auto rounded-sm ${isError ? 'border-red-500 text-red-600' : 'border-neutral-200'}`,
        innerHTML: `<span>${msg}</span>`
      });
      toastContainer.appendChild(toast);
      requestAnimationFrame(() => toast.classList.remove('translate-y-4', 'opacity-0'));
      setTimeout(() => {
        toast.classList.add('opacity-0', 'translate-y-4');
        setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 300);
      }, 2500);
    }

    // Wishlist toggle (heart)
    async function toggleHeart(productId, btn) {
      if (window.event) window.event.preventDefault();
      const icon = btn.querySelector('.heart-icon');
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/favorites/toggle', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRFToken': getCSRFToken() },
          body: JSON.stringify({ product_id: productId })
        });
        if (res.status === 401) {
          showToast('Vui lòng đăng nhập', true);
          setTimeout(() => location.href = '/auth/login', 1400);
          return;
        }
        const data = await res.json();
        if (data.status === 'success') {
          trackEvent({ product_id: productId, event_type: 'wishlist' });
          const added = data.action === 'added';
          icon?.classList.toggle('text-neutral-300', !added);
          icon?.classList.toggle('text-black', added);
          icon?.classList.toggle('fill-black', added);
          showToast(added ? 'Đã thêm vào yêu thích' : 'Đã xóa khỏi yêu thích');
        }
      } catch {
        showToast('Lỗi kết nối', true);
      }
    }

    // Lenis smooth scroll
    const lenis = new Lenis({ duration: 1.2, easing: t => Math.min(1, 1.001 - Math.pow(2, -10 * t)) });
    (function raf(time) {
      lenis.raf(time);
      requestAnimationFrame(raf);
    })(0);
  </script>


  {# ── Notification Bell Script ── #}
  {% if current_user.id %}
  <script>
  (function () {
    let _prevCount = -1;

    async function refreshNotifBadge() {
      try {
        const res  = await fetch('/notifications/unread-count', {
          headers: { 'X-CSRFToken': getCSRFToken() }
        });
        if (!res.ok) return;
        const { count } = await res.json();
        const n = parseInt(count) || 0;

        document.querySelectorAll('.notif-badge').forEach(badge => {
          badge.textContent = n > 99 ? '99+' : (n || '');
          badge.classList.toggle('is-zero', n === 0);
          // Pop animation khi số tăng
          if (_prevCount >= 0 && n > _prevCount) {
            badge.classList.remove('pop');
            void badge.offsetWidth; // reflow
            badge.classList.add('pop');
          }
        });
        _prevCount = n;
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    // Chạy ngay khi load + mỗi 60s
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', refreshNotifBadge);
    setInterval(refreshNotifBadge, 60_000);
  })();
  </script>
  {% endif %}

  {% block extra_scripts %}{% endblock %}
</body>

{# ── SCROLL FX + NOTIFICATION DROPDOWN LOGIC ── #}
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {

  // ── Scroll color FX ──────────────────────────────────────
  const nav = document.getElementById('mainNav');
  const updateNavTheme = () => {
    const isHome  = window.location.pathname === '/';
    const scrolled = window.scrollY > 50;
    if (isHome && !scrolled) {
      nav.classList.add('bg-transparent', 'text-white', 'border-transparent');
      nav.classList.remove('bg-white/95', 'backdrop-blur-md', 'text-black', 'border-neutral-100');
    } else {
      nav.classList.remove('bg-transparent', 'text-white', 'border-transparent');
      nav.classList.add('bg-white/95', 'backdrop-blur-md', 'text-black', 'border-neutral-100');
    }
  };
  updateNavTheme();
  window.addEventListener('scroll', updateNavTheme, { passive: true });

  // ── Dropdown mini: load thông báo khi hover ──────────────
  const dropdown   = document.getElementById('notifDropdown');
  const listEl     = document.getElementById('notifDropdownList');
  const emptyEl    = document.getElementById('notifDropdownEmpty');
  const bellParent = dropdown?.closest('.group');
  if (!dropdown || !bellParent) return;

  let loaded = false;

  bellParent.addEventListener('mouseenter', async () => {
    if (loaded) return;
    try {
      const res  = await fetch('/notifications/?filter=all&_partial=1', {
        headers: { 'X-CSRFToken': getCSRFToken(), 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' }
      });
      // Nếu backend chưa hỗ trợ partial, fallback dùng unread-count endpoint
      // và hiện thông báo đơn giản
      const count = parseInt(
        document.querySelector('.notif-badge')?.textContent?.trim() || '0'
      );
      if (count === 0) {
        emptyEl.innerHTML = `
          <svg class="w-8 h-8 mx-auto mb-2 text-neutral-200" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="1.5"
                  d="M14.857 17.082a23.848 23.848 0 005.454-1.31A8.967 8.967 0 0118 9.75V9A6 6 0 006 9v.75a8.967 8.967 0 01-2.312 6.022c1.733.64 3.56 1.085 5.455 1.31m5.714 0a24.255 24.255 0 01-5.714 0m5.714 0a3 3 0 11-5.714 0"/>
          </svg>
          Không có thông báo mới`;
      } else {
        emptyEl.innerHTML = `
          <a href="/notifications/" class="text-[11px] font-bold text-black uppercase tracking-wider hover:underline">
            Bạn có ${count} thông báo chưa đọc →
          </a>`;
      }
      loaded = true;
    } catch (_) {
      emptyEl.textContent = 'Không thể tải thông báo.';
    }
  });

});
</script>

  const container = document.getElementById('slider-container');
  const progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
  const btnNext = document.getElementById('btnNext');
  const btnPrev = document.getElementById('btnPrev');

  if (!container) return;

  const updateUI = () => {
    const maxScroll = container.scrollWidth - container.clientWidth;
    if (maxScroll <= 0) {
      progressBar.style.width = '100%';
      btnPrev.disabled = true;
      btnNext.disabled = true;
      return;
    }
    const scrollProgress = (container.scrollLeft / maxScroll) * 100;
    progressBar.style.width = scrollProgress + '%';
    btnPrev.disabled = container.scrollLeft <= 5;
    btnNext.disabled = container.scrollLeft >= maxScroll - 5;
  };

  container.addEventListener('scroll', updateUI, { passive: true });
  setTimeout(updateUI, 100);
  window.addEventListener('resize', updateUI);

  const getScrollStep = () => {
    const item = container.querySelector('.slider-item');
    return item ? item.offsetWidth + 24 : container.clientWidth * 0.5;
  };

  btnNext.addEventListener('click', () => container.scrollBy({ left: getScrollStep(), behavior: 'smooth' }));
  btnPrev.addEventListener('click', () => container.scrollBy({ left: -getScrollStep(), behavior: 'smooth' }));

  let isDown = false, startX, scrollLeft, isDragging = false;
  container.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
    isDown = true; isDragging = false;
    container.classList.remove('scroll-smooth');
    container.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
    startX = e.pageX - container.offsetLeft;
    scrollLeft = container.scrollLeft;
  });
  window.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
    isDown = false;
    container.style.cursor = 'auto';
    container.classList.add('scroll-smooth');
    if (isDragging) {
      const step = getScrollStep();
      const snapPoint = Math.round(container.scrollLeft / step) * step;
      container.scrollTo({ left: snapPoint, behavior: 'smooth' });
    }
    setTimeout(() => { isDragging = false; }, 50);
  });
  container.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
    if (!isDown) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const x = e.pageX - container.offsetLeft;
    const walk = (x - startX) * 1.5;
    if (Math.abs(walk) > 5) isDragging = true;
    container.scrollLeft = scrollLeft - walk;
  });
  container.querySelectorAll('a, button').forEach(el => {
    el.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if (isDragging) { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); } });
  });
});
</script>
{% endblock %}
</file>

            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="1.8" d="M21 8.25c0-2.485-2.099-4.5-4.688-4.5-1.935 0-3.597 1.126-4.312 2.733-.715-1.607-2.377-2.733-4.313-2.733C5.1 3.75 3 5.765 3 8.25c0 7.22 9 12 9 12s9-4.78 9-12z"/></svg>
          </button>

          {% if stock <= 0 %}<div class="p-sold">Sold Out</div>
          {% elif product.created_at and (product.created_at | string)[:10] >= (now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d') if now is defined else '2099') %}<div class="p-new">New</div>
          {% endif %}
        </div>

        <div class="p-info">
          <p class="p-cat">{{ cn }}</p>
          <a href="/product/{{ product.slug }}" class="p-name">{{ product.name }}</a>
          <p class="p-price">{{ "{:,.0f}".format(product.price).replace(',','.') }}<small style="font-size:.6em;font-weight:700;margin-left:2px;color:var(--text-light)"> ₫</small></p>
        </div>
      </article>
      {% endfor %}
    </div>

    <script id="fmeta" type="application/json">{"sizes":{{ ns.sizes|sort|tojson }},"colors":{{ ns.colors|sort|tojson }}}</script>
    {% endif %}
  </main>

        </div>
