  {% block extra_scripts %}
  <script>
  const _idx={};

  function openDrawer(){
    const o=document.getElementById('sOv');
    o.classList.add('show');
    setTimeout(()=>o.classList.add('vis'),10);
    document.getElementById('sDrawer').classList.add('open');
    document.body.style.overflow='hidden';
  }
  function closeDrawer(){
    const o=document.getElementById('sOv');
    o.classList.remove('vis');
    setTimeout(()=>o.classList.remove('show'),320);
    document.getElementById('sDrawer').classList.remove('open');
    document.body.style.overflow='';
  }

  /* ── HIỆU ỨNG CHUYỂN ẢNH SIÊU MƯỢT ── */
  function imgSlide(e, pid, d){
    e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
    const card = document.querySelector(`.p-card[data-id="${pid}"]`);
    if(!card) return;
    const imgs = JSON.parse(card.dataset.imgs||'[]');
    if(imgs.length < 2) return;
    
    _idx[pid] = ((_idx[pid]||0) + d + imgs.length) % imgs.length;
    
    const pm = card.querySelector('.pm');
    const ph = card.querySelector('.ph');
    
    // Khóa hiệu ứng hover CSS gốc để không bị giật
    pm.classList.remove('group-hover:opacity-0');
    ph.style.display = 'none';
    
    // Hiệu ứng mờ dần (Fade out)
    pm.style.transition = 'opacity 0.15s ease-out';
    pm.style.opacity = '0.3';
    
    // Sau khi mờ thì đổi ảnh và hiện lên (Fade in)
    setTimeout(() => {
        pm.src = imgs[_idx[pid]];
        pm.style.opacity = '1';
    }, 150);
  }

  function applyFilters(){
    const ls=document.getElementById('liveSearch');
    const term=(ls?ls.value:'').toLowerCase().trim();
    const sort=(document.querySelector('input[name="sort"]:checked')||{value:'newest'}).value;
    const cats=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.f-cat:checked')).map(c=>c.value);
    const sizes=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.f-sz:checked')).map(c=>c.value);
    const colors=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.f-cl:checked')).map(c=>c.value);
    const cards=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.p-card'));
    let vis=[];
    cards.forEach(c=>{
      let ok=true;
      if(term&&!c.dataset.name.includes(term)&&!c.dataset.category.includes(term))ok=false;
      if(ok&&cats.length&&!cats.includes(c.dataset.category))ok=false;
      if(ok&&sizes.length){const s=JSON.parse(c.dataset.sizes||'[]');if(!sizes.some(x=>s.includes(x)))ok=false;}
      if(ok&&colors.length){const cl=JSON.parse(c.dataset.colors||'[]');if(!colors.some(x=>cl.includes(x)))ok=false;}
      c.style.display=ok?'flex':'none';
      if(ok)vis.push(c);
    });
    vis.sort((a,b)=>{
      if(sort==='price_asc')return+a.dataset.price-+b.dataset.price;
      if(sort==='price_desc')return+b.dataset.price-+a.dataset.price;
      if(sort==='best')return+b.dataset.sold-+a.dataset.sold;
      return new Date(b.dataset.created)-new Date(a.dataset.created);
    });
    const g=document.getElementById('productGrid');
    if(g)vis.forEach(c=>g.appendChild(c));
    const n=vis.length;
    document.getElementById('pcount').textContent=n;
    document.getElementById('heroCount').textContent=n;
    const em=document.getElementById('emptyState');
    if(g)g.style.display=n?'grid':'none';
    if(em)em.classList.toggle('show',n===0);
  }

  function clearFilters(){
    document.querySelectorAll('.f-cat,.f-sz,.f-cl').forEach(c=>c.checked=false);
    const r=document.querySelector('input[name="sort"][value="newest"]');if(r)r.checked=true;
    const ls=document.getElementById('liveSearch');if(ls)ls.value='';
    const lsm=document.getElementById('liveSearchMobile');if(lsm)lsm.value='';
    applyFilters();
  }

  function showToast(m){
    const t=document.getElementById('sToast');
    t.textContent=m;t.classList.add('show');
    clearTimeout(t._t);t._t=setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('show'),2400);
  }

  function getFavs(){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('gua_favs')||'[]')}catch{return[]}}
  function setFavs(l){try{localStorage.setItem('gua_favs',JSON.stringify(l))}catch{}}

  async function toggleFav(e,btn){
    e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();
    const pid=String(btn.dataset.pid||'');if(!pid)return;
    const was=btn.classList.contains('on');
    btn.classList.toggle('on',!was);
    const csrf=(document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]')||{}).content||'';
    try{
      const r=await fetch('/api/favorites/toggle',{
        method:'POST',
        headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-CSRFToken':csrf},
        body:JSON.stringify({product_id:pid})
      });
      if(r.status===401){btn.classList.toggle('on',was);showToast('Vui lòng đăng nhập');return;}
      if(!r.ok){btn.classList.toggle('on',was);showToast('Có lỗi xảy ra');return;}
      let favs=getFavs();
      if(!was){if(!favs.includes(pid))favs.push(pid);}else{favs=favs.filter(id=>id!==pid);}
      setFavs(favs);
      showToast(!was?'Đã lưu vào bộ sưu tập ♥':'Đã bỏ yêu thích');
    }catch{btn.classList.toggle('on',was);showToast('Lỗi kết nối');}
  }

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',()=>{
    const meta=document.getElementById('fmeta');
    if(meta){
      const {sizes,colors}=JSON.parse(meta.textContent);
      const sc=document.getElementById('sSzChips'),cc=document.getElementById('sClChips');
      if(sizes.length&&sc){
        document.getElementById('sSzSec').style.display='';
        sizes.forEach(s=>{sc.innerHTML+=`<label class="s-chip-l"><input type="checkbox" class="f-sz" value="${s}" onchange="applyFilters()"><span class="s-chip">${s}</span></label>`;});
      }
      if(colors.length&&cc){
        document.getElementById('sClSec').style.display='';
        colors.forEach(c=>{cc.innerHTML+=`<label class="s-chip-l"><input type="checkbox" class="f-cl" value="${c}" onchange="applyFilters()"><span class="s-chip">${c}</span></label>`;});
      }
    }

    getFavs().forEach(pid=>{
      const b=document.querySelector(`.p-fav[data-pid="${pid}"]`);
      if(b)b.classList.add('on');
    });

    let dt;
    const ls=document.getElementById('liveSearch');
    if(ls)ls.addEventListener('input',()=>{clearTimeout(dt);dt=setTimeout(applyFilters,280);});

    document.querySelectorAll('.s-gcol').forEach(btn=>{
      btn.addEventListener('click',function(){
        document.querySelectorAll('.s-gcol').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('on'));
        this.classList.add('on');
        const g=document.getElementById('productGrid');
        if(!g)return;
        const c=this.dataset.c;
        g.className='s-grid fu fu2'+(c==='3'?' g3':c==='5'?' g5':'');
      });
    });

    document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')closeDrawer();});
  });
  </script>
  {% endblock %}
